task_description: In this scenario, three agents collaborate to analyze financial market data, make trading decisions, execute trades, and verify transactions. The agents must ensure that the data they use is current and accurate, execute orders in a timely manner, and keep consistent track of positions.
expected_outcome: All agents should collaborate seamlessly, leading to accurate analysis, timely trading decisions, correct order executions, and consistent position tracking.

agents.description: This agent gathers and analyzes financial market data to extract meaningful insights that assist in trading decisions.
This agent utilizes market insights to make informed trading decisions and evaluate associated risks.
This agent is responsible for executing trades based on decisions and verifying that transactions are completed accurately.
